_about: Stream lines drawn BY HAND for the added-streams batch (source key 'manual'): a channel no FWA line, city layer or OpenStreetMap way draws, traced by Claude on Esri World Imagery for a recorded owner decision. Vertex order is the flow (head first, mouth last: `build_dataset.RELIABLE_SOURCES`). Every feature is a PROPOSAL until the owner ticks it on its picture; its `note` quotes his words and says how sure the trace is.

properties.name: Sheldens Creek
properties.note: Owner 2026-11-16 20:01 (T806, Sheldens Creek, mark 2783), picked on the picture: "Extend to the bridge" (draw the creek on down to the SPUR 14 road bridge and put the low-confidence tidal boundary there); earlier: "have it be low confidence and set it top tidal too". The FWA line (blk 360846083) stops at the head of the salt marsh; this trace follows the main marsh channel from there (SW, round the west loop, east along the big channel, then north) to the road bridge (53.14746 N 131.76003 W, FTEN SPUR 14, beside the OSM camp site) and ~65 m on, to the open flats of Sheldens Bay. LOW CONFIDENCE: traced by eye on Esri World Imagery at z18; the marsh has many channels and which one carries the creek is a reading, not a survey. The first vertex is the FWA line's own mouth vertex (615733.858, 920150.919 in BC Albers), so the graph joins the two lines at one node.
